proposals.denominator_definition: distinct IDs with multiple normalized texts
proposals.action: Compare article structure and main content; retain rejected versions and reasons. Final selection follows cleaning QA.
Use stored title/desc and available HTML/body bylines; keep publication/date/author roles separate and null when unknown.

proposals.denominator_definition: distinct IDs with no nonempty text version
proposals.action: Separate offline-recovery candidates from empty-only records. Exclude irreparable versions from content indexing, without recrawling.

proposals.denominator_definition: flagged records, not all confirmed binary
proposals.action: Quarantine confirmed image/binary redirects; never guess lost characters or call it ordinary HTML cleanup.

proposals.denominator_definition: records with a lexical UI marker
proposals.action: Validate block positions and counterexamples; retain substantive article and medical caution paragraphs.
Keep clinical repetitions/lists; trim only proven contents/navigation/related-story spans.
Distinguish real gates from reCAPTCHA footer in an otherwise valid article. Do not reject by marker alone.

proposals.denominator_definition: records flagged by current word-overlap heuristic
proposals.action: Use CJK-aware diagnostics and review; shared topic substrings can make the current flag a false positive.

proposals.denominator_definition: distinct IDs with normalized text/block agreement
proposals.action: Map exact original spans first; support h/p/tr blocks and numbered headings inside p; preserve Q&A, conditions and numbers.
